t:
Paragraph (4) of section 3012(b) of title 38, United States Code, is amended to read as follows:


“(4) 
by reason of change in income or corpus of estate shall be the last day of the calendar year in which the change occurred;”

fable.w: This section only amends the effective date for reductions or discontinuances of veterans' benefits when income or corpus of estate changes. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue for any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading, since no participation-related language appears at all.

opus.w: This amendment only sets the effective date for a benefit change after a change in income or estate. It does not require the federal government to consult or coordinate with anyone outside the government before deciding anything. A beneficiary's link to veterans' benefits is not participation, because applying for or receiving benefits is excluded by the definition.
opus.s: by reason of change in income or corpus of estate shall be the last day of the calendar year in which the change occurred;
opus.b: The tempting reading would be that this involves veterans and their benefits, so outside parties might seem to play a role. That reading fails. The section only changes the date on which a benefit change takes effect after a change in income or estate. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue. In any case, applying for benefits does not count as participation.

qwen_chat.w: This section amends a statutory deadline for reporting changes in income or estate for veterans' benefits. It does not require or recommend any consultation, coordination, or participation by outside parties in a federal decision. It is a procedural rule regarding benefit administration, which falls under the exclusion for applications for benefits or grants.
qwen_chat.s: Paragraph (4) of section 3012(b) of title 38, United States Code, is amended to read as follows: “(4) by reason of change in income or corpus of estate shall be the last day of the calendar year in which the change occurred;”
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that changing the deadline for reporting income changes affects veterans (outside parties) and thus involves them. However, this is merely a procedural amendment to a reporting deadline for benefit adjustments, not a mechanism for public consultation, advisory input, or participation in a federal decision-making process. The definition explicitly excludes applications for benefits or grants, and this text does not grant any right to sue, comment, or be consulted.
